dependency: Task 198 runner output, port 8012 eighteen-row proof and GitHub remote readback must exist before any Task 199 automation or queue contract is created.
geometry_policy: No new coordinates, polygons, building footprints or parcel boundaries are created or inferred. Every selected row remains NOT_BOUND.

features.name: Castle Howard
features.official_source_evidence: The official Castle Howard estate site identifies the North Yorkshire house, gardens, visitor attraction and wider estate; authoritative heritage records identify the principal structure as a privately owned country house and Grade I stately home.
features.classification_finding: The principal house identity is strong, but the tracked visitor destination includes gardens and estate land. The main house must be isolated and the ordinary Detached Home taxonomy reviewed against heritage and visitor use.

features.name: Principal Tower
features.official_source_evidence: The named residential development site presents Principal Tower, its apartments, penthouses, amenities and location; authoritative building records identify it as a completed 50-storey residential tower with 298 apartments.
features.classification_finding: Apartment Building is strongly supported. Exact evidence must bind Principal Tower itself and not the adjacent Principal Place office building.

features.name: One Crown Place
features.official_source_evidence: The official development site describes private apartments, office accommodation, retail units, a boutique hotel, restaurant, bars and club lounges at One Crown Place.
features.classification_finding: Mixed-use character is authoritative, but One Crown Place is a multi-building development rather than one simple Mixed Building. A named component or defensible development parcel must be selected before exact geometry binding.

features.name: NOMA Manchester
features.official_source_evidence: The official NOMA masterplan and estate material presents a Manchester district containing offices, homes, hotels, shops, restaurants, bars and multiple named buildings.
features.classification_finding: Mixed-use identity is strongly supported, but NOMA is a broad masterplan and estate rather than one Mixed Building. A named building or exact parcel is required before geometry binding.

features.name: Silverburn Shopping Centre
features.official_source_evidence: The official Silverburn domain presents shops, restaurants, leisure and visitor information for the Pollok, Glasgow shopping centre; current published reporting continues to identify it as a major retail and leisure destination.
features.classification_finding: Retail Property is strongly supported. The centre boundary must remain distinct from surrounding car parks and neighbouring land, but no property-type conflict is present.

features.name: Lakeside Shopping Centre
features.official_source_evidence: The official Lakeside domain presents the West Thurrock centre through shopping, dining, leisure and visitor functions; authoritative published records identify a large out-of-town shopping centre with more than two hundred stores.
features.classification_finding: Retail Property is strongly supported. The shopping-centre footprint must be separated from the wider retail park, lake, transport and parking estate before geometry binding.
